models.model: F315 + 50% upcoming-week calibrated Sharks / retained NIG uncertainty
models.mean_method: week-specific native three-input regression centered on observed league YTD PPG; forecast-week same-roster bye losses
models.weekly_volatility: league-wide normalized weekly SD; residual-matched to the bye-adjusted mean
models.strength_uncertainty: week-specific persistent Normal team offset, residual-matched to the bye-adjusted mean

potential_points.validation: 2023 selection; rolling 2024-2025 holdout; residual downward bias remains

models.description: All forecasts use one scoring model. Current Potential PPG and prior GM performance estimate team scoring ability, anchored to league YTD PPG. The upcoming week blends that estimate equally with calibrated Fantasy Sharks projections for submitted starters, using calibrated YTD PPG when a Sharks projection is unavailable. Later weeks retain the underlying team forecast. Future-week bye adjustments use the selected week’s roster and estimated player scoring, allowing for eligible replacements. Weekly scores follow a fitted Normal-inverse-Gaussian distribution with a persistent team-strength offset. H2H, Playoffs and all five Bonus Games share the same simulated scores.
